description: Score who a weekly wall-clock time punishes, including a daylight-saving week when one falls in the next 26 weeks. Use for "Monday 9am PT standup for San Francisco, London, and Bangalore". weekday is a day name. time is a clock such as 9am. home is the IANA timezone of that clock. Paste shareText. The kinder slot and plannerUrl come from the meeting engine. If a week has context, tell the user that sentence. It says whether daylight saving skipped that local time or made it happen twice.

_endUserId.description: Optional opaque per-call end-user attribution token populated by the MCP host, not the LLM. Use a non-PII hash or token; never send raw email, name, or platform user ID.

anyOf.description: Optional ISO country hints aligned to locations.
Optional ISO country hints aligned to locations.

durationMinutes.description: Optional. Only 30, 45, or 60 are written onto the planner link.

home.description: IANA timezone of the recurring clock, such as America/Los_Angeles.

anyOf.description: Two or more cities or timezones.
Two or more cities or timezones.

now.description: Optional ISO instant used as "today" when choosing the next weekday. Defaults to the current time.

occurrences.description: How many weeks to score before adding a DST week. Default 4. Max 8.

time.description: Clock time such as 9am or 09:00 in the home timezone.

weekday.description: Day name such as Mon or Monday. 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday.

workEnd.description: Last in-hours local hour, inclusive. Default 18.

name: rank_recurring_slot
